name: sujal-fullstack-portfolio
description: Full-stack portfolio with React.js frontend and Node.js backend

scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'server'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
